name: splicewire/laravel-beam
description: The schema-driven-CMS core: composes the open schema foundation (schemastud/laravel-data-schemas) and the open versioning foundation (rushing/laravel-versioning) into a schema-typed, snapshot-versioned, migrate-on-read SchemaRecord. Depends DOWN on both open foundations (the allowed ADR-0092 direction; frame → beam → data-schemas is a diamond, not a cycle) and relocates nothing out of them. Also the runtime home of the generic media model traits and the host-hook registries (webhook / sitemap / doctor). Boots headless — frame (the editor rung) depends on beam, never the reverse (ADR-0082 layering). No Beam model is minted; beam is a substrate, not an instance.
